title: CLAUDE.md Guide HowTo: Step-by-step authoring and maintenance
desc: Step-by-step guide for maintaining CLAUDE.md files, situation-specific remedies A-H, and how to use the two-layer system correctly.
steps: Situation A -- new repo with no CLAUDE.md: create the minimum template with build command, architecture, gg section starting with on-load and ending with repo-health-doctor.|Situation B -- a command just failed: delete or fix that line immediately, commit with the code change it describes.|Situation C -- new gotcha discovered: append one line under Gotchas section, commit same session.|Situation D -- new recurring pattern established: add to gg Main Workflow steps.|Situation E -- file exceeds 100 lines: trim stale content first; if still long, extract patterns into a skill and leave a pointer.|Situation F -- same subject drifts between CLAUDE.md and README.md: fix both in one commit.|Situation G -- session ending after significant work: scan for stale content, run wkappbot skill read handoff-checklist.|Situation H -- before release or repo feels stale: close open issues, run wkappbot skill read repo-health-doctor.
author: claude
